body: [{"streamId":"01a18cd2-dd3e-7625-81bb-f3c294049b01","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a18cd2-dd3e-7625-81bb-f3c294049b01\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022A pull-request review pre-flight replicated from another node applies on the receiving node instead of being held forever, and a verdict from outside the node\\u0027s own fleet never satisfies the pre-flight gate.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022A pre-flight stream replicated to a node that has never held it applies on arrival: its dispatched and terminal events appear in that node\\u0027s pre-flight documents, and neither enters the held table.\u0022,\u0022On a build with this fix, pre-flight streams already held and given up apply and leave the held table without a human acting, when a node holding them can answer, and \\u0060h9k status\\u0060 no longer counts them as given up.\u0022,\u0022A completed safe verdict dispatched by a node of this node\\u0027s own owner satisfies the pre-flight gate for the same task and head.\u0022,\u0022A completed safe verdict dispatched by a node of any other owner does not satisfy the gate: this node runs its own pre-flight instead.\u0022,\u0022A node never reattaches, abandons or retargets a pre-flight row another node dispatched.\u0022,\u0022A test fails if a stream family the replication resolver recognises has no stream-starting event named in \\u0060AggregateGenesisEventTypes\\u0060.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022\\u0060PrReviewPreflightDispatched\\u0060 is classified project-scoped (\\u0060EventScopeRegistry.cs:409\\u0060) but missing from \\u0060AggregateGenesisEventTypes.IsGenesis\\u0060, so \\u0060EventReplicationInbox.cs:1376\\u0060 holds the genesis itself and the held-tail sweep asks the fleet for a record it already has. Observed on one node on v0.14.0: 335 streams held in one team project, 4,155 asks, 12,994 declines, and about 1,000 fresh asks in a burst at each upgrade, because an upgrade clears every give-up. Present since v0.11.0.\\n\\nThe gate is \\u0060RunLauncher.EnsurePrReviewPreflightSafeAsync\\u0060; \\u0060PrReviewPreflightCompleted\\u0060 has no entry in \\u0060TaskActClassificationRegistry\\u0060. Today the hold is accidentally the only thing keeping another owner\\u0027s verdict out of that gate, so the genesis entry must never ship without the owner check. Check whether a node can claim another owner\\u0027s PrReview task before settling how criterion 4 is implemented.\u0022,\u0022Constraints\u0022:null,\u0022ExternalReference\u0022:null,\u0022AddedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:39:51.885855\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022AddedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022\u0022,\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:[],\u0022StartsAsDraft\u0022:true,\u0022SourceIdeaId\u0022:null,\u0022EpicId\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproved\u0022:false,\u0022Origin\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproval\u0022:\u0022Off\u0022,\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:null,\u0022SecondaryExternalReference\u0022:null,\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:null,\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:null,\u0022InitialScope\u0022:\u0022Fleet\u0022}","originEventId":"96d282dd-9c71-4ffe-b057-5ec096743d2f","originSequence":145501,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:39:51.924509+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
